'''Josh Certo''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Red 93 from Soulsbyville, Ca. The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.

He was a music educator and freelance musician in Soulsbyville, northeast of Modesto.<ref name="decsq-prof" />

== In their own words ==

<blockquote>
Isn't it great to be involved with such an interesting game with such incredible players! I am honored to be a squadron member and to help you players out there with anything I can. As for my home region I plan to expand the player base, get more tournaments going, and put my ideas in to make the game as good as it can be.

I am a music educator and freelance musician, which means while I starve in the off season at least I can play Star Wars!!!!<ref name="decsq-prof" />
</blockquote>

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables.
